{{Quote|TI need you to go find Rodius Tharn. He's a male Rodian. Bring him back here to pick up the information that I lifted from the Imperials.|[[Kormund Thrylle]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KT" />}}
'''Rodius Tharn''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] and [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|They were trying to arrest me on some made up charges!|Rodius Tharn, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:KT" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]],Rodius Tharn was stationed on the planet [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="SWG:KT" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> Tharn needed to collect important [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] documents from a [[Spy/Legends|spy]] named [[Kormund Thrylle]]. However, the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]], who was almost arrested, needed help finding Kormund. Fortunately, Kormund tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with finding Rodius. Despite the intervention of the [[Tatooine militia]], the spacer escorted Rodius safely to [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]], where Kormund was stationed.<ref name="SWG:KT" />
